name: CHAIN Practice Simulator [CHOKE]
desc:
The first half of update is here! I hope y'all enjoy it!

CHAIN Practice Simulator is a game where you can practice freely the QTEs from an another Roblox Game titled of CHAIN, to get yourself better at the game and practice more.

This game is on early access, which it means that everything may be subject to change, or even more things will be added, i made the QTEs as more accurate as possible to the game, and the dificulty it heavily depends on your FPS, so good luck, and practice.

Supported Devices:
- PC
- Mobile
- Xbox/Playstation

All credits goes to Yurixzaaa and her Team Development.

scripts.title: Auto clash or qte
scripts.features:
auto clash/qte
VIM used! not supported by xeno or some bs executors
open source made by ai
scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local mechanicsFrame
for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
    local found = child:FindFirstChild("MechanicsFrame")
    if found then
        mechanicsFrame = found
        break
    end
end
if not mechanicsFrame then return end

local qte = mechanicsFrame:WaitForChild("QTE")
local label = qte:FindFirstChild("PC", true)
if not label then return end

local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local function pressKeyOnce(key)
    VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, key, false, game)
    task.wait(0.05)
    VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, key, false, game)
end

local function getKeyCode(text)
    if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil end
    text = text:gsub("%s+", "")
    if text == "" then return nil end
    return Enum.KeyCode[text:upper()]
end

local INITIAL_DELAY = 0.09
local SPAM_INTERVAL = 0.03
local currentSpamThread = nil

local function stopSpam()
    if currentSpamThread then
        task.cancel(currentSpamThread)
        currentSpamThread = nil
    end
end

local function startSpam(key)
    stopSpam()
    currentSpamThread = task.spawn(function()
        if not qte.Visible then return end
        task.wait(INITIAL_DELAY)
        if not qte.Visible then return end
        if getKeyCode(label.Text) ~= key then return end

        while true do
            if not qte.Visible then break end
            pressKeyOnce(key)
            task.wait(SPAM_INTERVAL)
            if getKeyCode(label.Text) ~= key then break end
        end
        currentSpamThread = nil
    end)
end

local function onTextChanged()
    if not qte.Visible then return end
    local txt = label.Text
    if txt == "" then return end
    local key = getKeyCode(txt)
    if key then startSpam(key) end
end

label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(onTextChanged)
qte:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
    if qte.Visible and label.Text ~= "" then
        onTextChanged()
    else
        stopSpam()
    end
end)

task.wait(0.5)
if qte.Visible and label.Text ~= "" then
    onTextChanged()
end
